Name: T-Rex
Description: The Tyrannosaurus Rex is a large carnivorous dinosaur that lived during the late Cretaceous period. It is known for its massive size, powerful jaws, and sharp teeth. The T-Rex was one of the largest land predators of its time and is often depicted as a fearsome creature in popular culture.

Name: Pteranodon
Description: The Pteranodon is a genus of pterosaur that lived during the late Cretaceous period. It is known for its large wingspan and distinctive crest on its head. Pteranodons were flying reptiles, not dinosaurs, and are often depicted as soaring over the prehistoric landscape.

Name: Triceratops
Description: The Triceratops is a genus of herbivorous dinosaur that lived during the late Cretaceous period. It is known for its three distinctive facial horns and large bony frill at the back of its head. Triceratops was one of the largest ceratopsians and is often depicted as a formidable herbivore.

Name: Raptor
Description: The Raptor is a genus of small to medium-sized carnivorous dinosaur that lived during the late Cretaceous period. It is known for its sharp claws and agility. Raptors are often depicted as pack hunters, using their speed and intelligence to hunt down prey.

Name: Argentavis
Description: The Argentavis is a genus of large bird-like dinosaur that lived during the late Cretaceous period. It is known for its impressive wingspan and predatory nature. Argentavis was one of the largest flying birds and is often depicted as a powerful aerial predator.

Name: Brontosaurus
Description: The Brontosaurus is a genus of large herbivorous dinosaur that lived during the late Jurassic period. It is known for its long neck and massive size. Brontosaurus was one of the largest land animals and is often depicted as a gentle giant, feeding on vegetation in prehistoric landscapes.

Name: Giganotosaurus
Description: The Giganotosaurus is a genus of large carnivorous dinosaur that lived during the late Cretaceous period. It is known for its massive size and powerful jaws. Giganotosaurus was one of the largest land predators and is often depicted as a fearsome hunter in prehistoric environments.

Name: Stegosaurus
Description: The Stegosaurus is a genus of herbivorous dinosaur that lived during the late Jurassic period. It is known for its distinctive double row of large bony plates along its back and its spiked tail. Stegosaurus was one of the most recognizable dinosaurs and is often depicted as a slow-moving herbivore.

Name: Mosasaurus
Description: The Mosasaurus is a genus of large marine reptile that lived during the late Cretaceous period. It is known for its massive size and predatory nature. Mosasaurus was one of the largest marine predators and is often depicted as a fearsome hunter in prehistoric oceans.

Name: Spinosaurus
Description: The Spinosaurus is a genus of large carnivorous dinosaur that lived during the late Cretaceous period. It is known for its distinctive sail-like structure on its back and its semi-aquatic lifestyle. Spinosaurus was one of the largest land predators and is often depicted as a formidable hunter in both land and water.
